opening.argument: The sequence is an instructional Firefox configuration workflow. The presenter explains that viewers should open the menu to change the default search engine, then return to Firefox options and select the newly added engine. The visible Search settings page and Ecosia add-on result reinforce that the subject is browser setup and testing a search choice. Nothing in these instructions requests payment, credentials, investment participation, or another financial action. Disclosed affiliate links remain ordinary promotional context, separate from the Firefox guidance and unconnected to any deceptive offer.

citations.quote: The first thing we need to do to change the default search engine in Firefox is simply open the menu by selecting the 3 horizontal lines in the top right.
Once it's installed all we need to do is go back to the Firefox options, and then in the drop down we'll find our new desired search engine and we can select it.
